title: Reminder (PROVISIONAL)
$comment: PROVISIONAL — NOT the published contract. PROJ-404 ('Define and publish data contracts — org, contact, reminder') is the authority and is still To Do. It is described as a day-1 ticket so Dilraj and Prabhjot can code against the shapes without waiting for the implementation; since it has not landed, PROJ-439 needed a shape to build the form against. This file is that shape, written down where it can be diffed rather than buried in code. When PROJ-404 publishes, diff against this, migrate store/reminders.json, and delete this file. Fields are deliberately minimal: the fewer invented fields, the cheaper the migration.

org_id.description: Owning org. Null until Accounts & Multi-tenancy (PROJ-392) lands — there is no tenancy model yet, so nothing can be scoped. Every read is currently unscoped; this MUST become required before the app is multi-tenant.

contact_id.description: Who the reminder is for. Null until the contacts store (PROJ-417) lands. Not validated against a contact today because there is nothing to validate against.

title.description: What the reminder is about. Shown in the list view (PROJ-438).

due_at.description: When to send. Stored as ISO 8601 WITH an offset. A naive datetime from the form's datetime-local input is interpreted in the server's local zone and normalised on write — storing naive timestamps is how reminders end up firing hours off.

channel.description: Delivery channel. Per-contact preference and quiet hours are PROJ-400/PROJ-440 and are NOT consulted yet.

status.description: Lifecycle. Only 'scheduled' and 'cancelled' are reachable from the UI; 'sent' and 'failed' are set by the Reminders Engine (PROJ-395), which does not exist.
